look_here_first: Start with the foliage and bud shape. Berlandier's sundrops has very narrow linear leaves, a low spreading perennial/subshrub habit, bright yellow 4-petaled flowers, and distinctly 4-angled/square flower buds.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers generally diurnal compared with classic evening primroses

lookalikes.differences: O. laciniata has much broader cut-lobed leaves. O. capillifolia is the fine-leaved yellow sundrop concept historically called Calylophus.
